out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND POST FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RED BEANS AT 44-50F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR (RIGHT); HALF AND HALF AT 46F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 46-50F, BIRRIA SAUCE AT 49F, SALSA AT 46F, SOUR CREAM AT 47F AND CHIPOTLE SAUCE AT 46F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR (LEFT)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK IN REFRIGERATOR (LEFT) AT 47F AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN REFRIGERATOR UNITL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions: QUATERNARY AMMONIA.
violations.corrective_action: EDUCATION PROVIDED. Obtain QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL COPY TO PIC. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNED COPIES ARE MAINTAINED ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRINKING FROM OPEN CUP IN KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES ARE TRAINED AND COMPLY WITH USING CUPS WITH LIDS IN KITCHEN AND FOOD PREP AREAS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT 75F TO 92F AT HANDWASH SINKS IN FRONT SERVICE AND KITCHEN AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE MINIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 100F IS AVAILABLE AT ALL HANDWASHING SINKS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL EMAIL SIGNAGE TO PIC. PLEASE ENSURE ALL HANDWASHING SINKS ARE PROVIDED WITH SIGNAGE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CORN AT 119F, BLACK BEANS AT 121F, QUESO AT 101F IN STEAM TABLE OPPOSITE GRILL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE FOODS REHEATED TO 165F OR ABOVE BEFORE RETURN TO STEAM TABLE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS STORED IN REFRIGERATOR OVERNIGHT ARE REHEATED TO 165F OR ABOVE BEFORE PLACING IN STEAM TABLE. TACO ZOCALO (Inspection Date: 02/06/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: BLACK BEANS, BIRRIA SAUCE AND OTHER IN-HOUSE SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR (RIGHT)
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED ON SHELVING WITH FOODS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED CHICKEN CHIMICHANGAS AT 81F (1.5 HOURS) IN TURBO AIR 2 DRAWER UNDER COUNTER (GRILL).
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED FOODS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING. PLEASE ENSURE ALL INGREDIENTS ARE COOLED TO 41F BEFORE ASSEMBLING CHIMICHANGAS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the HOLES OR GAPS IN CEILING AROUND UTILITY LINES; MISSING CEILING TILES.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE SEAL GAPS AND REPLACE MISSING CEILING TILES. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR UNDER COUNTER IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR STORAGE OF FOODS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions: FOR CHLORINE (BLEACH) SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a CHLORINE (BLEACH) test kit. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
